jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Shopify) - LATAM
jobs.description:
About the Job

AOA is hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build polished, high-performing storefronts for ambitious eCommerce brands, and to be the technical lead for our Shopify work. You will turn thoughtful designs and product direction into production-ready commerce experiences, bringing the care, judgment, and craft that make a storefront fast, reliable, and easy to buy from.

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys ownership, but not isolation. We keep specifications lean because we trust strong engineers to think deeply, ask good questions, and shape the technical path forward. You will break product-level goals into clear engineering work, make sound implementation decisions, and own the details a great storefront needs, across both modern headless builds and classic Shopify.

As our Shopify technical lead, you will set the standard for how we build on Shopify, review and oversee Shopify work across the agency, and be the person the team relies on for the platform. You will work across a portfolio of client projects, partnering with designers, product leads, backend engineers, and client-facing teammates to move work forward with clarity and care. As an AI-native agency, we use modern AI coding tools and agents to increase speed, quality, and focus, while keeping strong human judgment at the center of the final product.

You may be a strong fit if you are a senior frontend engineer with deep React and Shopify experience, you take pride in excellent storefronts, you enjoy turning ambiguity into thoughtful implementation, you communicate clearly, and you want to do high-quality work with a close-knit team that cares deeply about client outcomes.

Role Details

  • Compensation: $5,000 USD per month
  • Engagement: Contract (independent contractor)
  • Location: Remote, based in Latin America
  • Schedule: Available during standard business hours in US Central Time, for strong overlap with the team
  • Reports to: Engineering Manager

About AOA

AOA is a growing digital design and development agency that creates high-impact websites, standout eCommerce experiences, and AI-native apps for ambitious modern brands.

We partner closely with eCommerce and SaaS companies to deliver thoughtful, polished work that drives meaningful results and lasting client success. Our work spans strategy, design, development, eCommerce, conversion optimization, and custom application development.

We are a close-knit team where every person has a direct, visible impact on our clients' success and the growth of the company. We value genuine relationships, high standards, ownership, clear communication, and a true commitment to client delight.

As an AI-native agency, we use modern tools to enhance the quality, speed, and clarity of our work, while keeping human judgment, creativity, and relationships at the center.

Responsibilities

  • Key Outcome: Deliver high-quality, high-performing eCommerce frontend experiences that AOA is known for, with predictability, agentic-efficiency, and collaborative ownership.
  • Build production-grade storefronts in React and modern headless commerce frameworks such as Shopify Hydrogen.
  • Develop and customize classic Shopify: Liquid themes, apps, Checkout Extensions, and store configuration.
  • Serve as AOA's Shopify technical lead: set the Shopify standard, review and oversee Shopify work, and be the platform authority the team relies on.
  • Lead Shopify migrations and establish CI/CD and deployment pipelines for themes and apps.
  • Turn product-level objectives into clear, actionable engineering tasks and own the technical approach.
  • Translate Figma designs into reusable storefront components and design-system primitives that help the team ship faster.
  • Connect storefronts to commerce and content APIs, handling variants, inventory, pricing, loading, errors, empty states, and partial data.
  • Plan and sequence your work across multiple client projects, bringing recommendations rather than open-ended problems.
  • Write tested, maintainable TypeScript that follows each client codebase's conventions.
  • Self-review your work and catch issues before QA, with particular care on revenue-bearing flows.
  • Conduct code reviews and hold the bar on quality across the work you review.
  • Use AI coding tools and agents thoughtfully while keeping engineering judgment in control.
  • Communicate proactively across a remote team, sharing progress and surfacing risks early.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building production frontend applications, with deep, current React and TypeScript expertise.
  • 4+ years building and owning Shopify experience across classic and headless builds.
  • Prior experience working in an agency environment and as an independent contractor, with the ability to manage multiple clients or projects in parallel.
  • Strong experience on enterprise-grade accounts, products, or projects.
  • Strong experience in Liquid theme development (Online Store 2.0), Shopify apps, Checkout Extensions, store configuration, and migrations.
  • Experience as the senior technical authority on Shopify: setting the standard, reviewing and overseeing others' Shopify work, and owning CI/CD and version control for themes or apps.
  • A track record of owning storefront features end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to production.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, accessibility, and browser behavior.
  • Experience translating Figma designs into accurate, responsive, accessible interfaces.
  • Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs (Storefront API or similar) and managing client and server state, including cart.
  • A strong quality discipline: typed, tested code and self-review before QA.
  • Ability to estimate your work, commit within a delivery cycle, and reliably deliver.
  • Excellent professional English, spoken and written, with reliable overlap with standard US Central Time business hours.
  • Fluent, practical use of AI coding tools as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Based in Latin America and able to work as an independent contractor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other headless commerce stacks (such as commercetools or BigCommerce) or with SaaS and B2B product frontends in Next.js, in addition to Shopify.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library used across multiple storefronts or products.
  • Familiarity with frontend testing and CI tooling, such as Playwright, Vitest or Jest, and Testing Library.
  • Experience with conversion optimization, A/B testing, or analytics instrumentation on commerce sites.
  • Experience working in a points-based or sprint-based delivery model.
  • A portfolio, GitHub, or code samples you can share.

You do not need to check every single box to apply. We know strong engineers bring the right experience in different ways. If you build excellent storefronts in React and Shopify, take real ownership of your work, and want to lead Shopify at an AI-native agency, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend & Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Forager is a leading provider of person and organization data, powering enrichment, search, and discovery for B2B platforms worldwide. Our APIs and bulk data feeds deliver billions of data points daily - used by the most widely used go-to-market and sales-intelligence platforms.

Our data is refreshed on an industry-leading ~2.5-week cycle: 200M+ verified mobile numbers at a 99% accuracy rate, 850M+ person and company records, and 100M+ intent signals ingested every month.

We're a small, remote team, shipping fast with high autonomy and little-to-no bureaucracy.

The Role

You'll own the backend, data, and infrastructure that deliver Forager's data to platform customers at scale - from ingestion all the way through to the APIs and feeds customers integrate against. This is a backend-first role: most of your time is spent building API features, operating our search and ETL data infrastructure, and owning the DevOps and platform layer underneath it. You'll also contribute to our customer-facing React/TypeScript web app, but that's the minority of the work.

This is a senior, high-ownership role on a small team. You won't just contribute features - you'll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You'll have direct input into product direction and the freedom (and responsibility) to ship work that materially moves our coverage, accuracy, latency, and uptime metrics. You'll grow into full ownership of the platform over time, taking areas over from our CTO as you ramp up - you won't be thrown in the deep end on day one.

What You'll Own

Ranked by where your time goes:

Backend & API development - real-time enrichment APIs (person/org lookup, contact data, reverse search), search and filter endpoints, waterfall enrichment logic, and the credit/billing surfaces customers meter against. Match rate, latency, and freshness directly drive customer value.

  • Design, build, and operate RESTful APIs and scalable backend services - workers, task queues, waterfall lookups, data pipelines - that keep refresh cycles predictable and fill rates high.
  • Build the metering, credit-logging, and billing logic customers rely on for accurate consumption, and help shape which features have the highest impact.

Data engineering, ETL & search infrastructure - own the Elasticsearch/ECK stack end-to-end: index and mapping design, ingestion, relevance tuning, cluster health, scaling, and migrations.

  • Design and operate the ETL applications that move billions of data points daily into searchable stores, Snowflake data products, and warehouse exports (S3) while holding fill rates and accuracy.
  • Optimize PostgreSQL (query performance, indexing, caching) and drive measurable improvements in latency, uptime, error rate, fill rate, and scalability.

DevOps & platform (core owner) - own day-to-day AWS infrastructure (ECS, S3), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD. This is not shared-on-the-side ops: you're responsible for infrastructure modernization, deployment pipelines, security scanning, and log/metric consolidation.

  • Own observability - Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry - and on-call response for the surfaces you build.
  • Drive infrastructure modernization

Observability & data-quality tooling - build Grafana dashboards, load tests, and data-accuracy evals that make coverage, freshness, latency, and correctness measurable and continuously monitored.

Customer-facing web app (minority) - contribute to the React/TypeScript app, docs, onboarding, and self-serve surfaces when the work calls for it.

Quality & collaboration (across all of the above) - code review with high standards for readability, security, and performance; unit, integration, and E2E tests treated as a quality contributor, not overhead; and clear docs for features, architecture, and API contracts, since great developer docs are how our customers succeed.

Working Arrangement

This is a full-time, fully remote, contract role (B2B / independent contractor). We're currently hiring across Serbia, Poland, Ukraine, Colombia, Brazil, and Argentina, but we're open to strong candidates based elsewhere - reach out even if your country isn't listed.

The one fixed expectation: roughly 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time. Beyond that, we care about output and overlap, not clock-watching.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours - set your own schedule around that overlap window.
  • Untracked PTO - take the time off you need; there's no accrual to count.
  • Relaxed working environment - small team, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. Anyone can take an idea to production without jumping through hoops.
jobs.requirementsSection:
What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems and APIs, with clear examples of strategic technical problem-solving (not just tenure).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, ideally with Django REST Framework.
  • Hands-on experience operating Elasticsearch / OpenSearch at scale - index/mapping design, query and relevance tuning, cluster management, migrations.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating ETL pipelines that move significant data volumes reliably.
  • Production experience with a relational database, caching, and async task/queue systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery / RabbitMQ or equivalents preferred).
  • Core-owner-level comfort with AWS (ECS, S3, CloudWatch), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent) - you're comfortable owning the platform, not just deploying to it.
  • Experience operating services in production - observability, on-call, incident response (on-call here is light, not nightly firefighting)
  • Working proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework - comfortable shipping product UI when the work calls for it (React / TypeScript preferred). This is the minority of the role, not its center.
  • Strong written communication; comfortable owning documentation as a deliverable.

AI-augmented Engineering (Required)

AI coding tools are core to how we build, and you'll be expected to work effectively in an AI-augmented environment from day one. This isn't a nice-to-have - it's how the team ships. We're looking for strong, hands-on fluency with:

  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) for implementation, refactoring, and code review - and the discipline to validate everything they produce before it reaches production.
  • Driving the tools to a good result, not just a fast one - steering an agent toward an efficient, correct solution, measuring and comparing outcomes rather than accepting the first output, and reviewing generated code for quality you'd put your name on.
  • Judgment about where AI helps vs. hurts - knowing when to delegate to the tool, when to write it yourself, and how to keep it on rails for production work.

We test this directly with a hands-on exercise, so what matters is real working fluency, not buzzwords - e.g., you regularly use these tools to solve non-trivial engineering problems and can show how you got to a good solution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or other data warehouses.
  • Background in B2B data products - enrichment, contact data, company data, search/discovery.
  • Experience with web crawling, data sourcing, or large-scale ingestion systems.
  • Open-source contributions or public technical writing.

jobs.title: Senior Software / Platform Engineer (IR-549)
jobs.description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe.We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net/

We are looking for a capable developer to support daily operations while our primary team executes a database modernization from SQL Server to AWS Aurora. You will need to switch fluidly between backend maintenance in Java and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi (TypeScript).

A technology and consulting company specializing in customer loyalty, personalization, data analytics, and AI-powered solutions for large enterprise brands across industries such as travel, hospitality, retail, and entertainment. The company combines consulting expertise with a SaaS loyalty platform, helping clients design, implement, and optimize loyalty programs, improve customer engagement, and use data and AI to deliver personalized experiences.
